name: bada-music-studio
description: Bada Music Studio — a self-contained digital audio workstation (DAW). Multi-track arranger with clips, piano roll, 16/32-step drum sequencer with ten synthesized drum voices, a two-oscillator subtractive synthesizer (unison, multimode filter with envelope and LFO, dual ADSR), per-track drive / 3-band EQ / chorus plus reverb and tempo-synced ping-pong delay sends, a mixer with metering, and export to WAV (offline-rendered), stems, standard MIDI files and JSON projects. Zero dependencies, single HTML file, fully offline.
author: Masaaki Yamaguchi
